note: ADR 1127: a named function expression (`const cb = function inner() {}`) is entered through the binding holding it as well as through its own name. A call through `cb` in the body runs the read untracked: Chrome warns, and the checker reports the call as it does for an arrow (main: clean, the call graph keyed the function by `inner` only). A callback also named by a primitive and called by name keeps its row; a handler call and an uncalled callback stay quiet.
